content: {"praised": ["Stephen Amell delivers compelling, sympathetic performance as Oliver Queen.", "Characters show deep emotion and complex motivations.", "Storylines weave past and present effectively.", "Villains and heroes are nuanced, not black and white.", "Cast talent surpasses typical TV series standards."], "criticized": ["Season 2 feels like unresolved soap opera.", "Episodes leave hanging plot points repeatedly.", "Mirakuru concept lacks credibility and feels too comic bookish.", "Writing drags into excessive drama and misery.", "Tone shifts from grim reality to far‑out fantasy."]}
